# vcp_affinity_groups (Data Source)

Fetches list of all affinity groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all affinity groups in the project.
data "vcp_affinity_groups" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `affinity_groups` (Attributes List) List of affinity groups (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--affinity_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--affinity_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `affinity_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Affinity group ID
- `location_id` (String) Location ID
- `name` (String) Affinity group name
- `policy` (String) Placement policy
- `server_ids` (Set of String) Server IDs
